title: POST /api/projects/:id/share/enable — generate public share token
description: Enable project sharing by generating a unique UUID share token and setting is_public = true on the project.
acceptanceCriteria: POST requires auth and project ownership
Generates a UUID v4 share_token if one doesn't exist
Sets is_public = true on the project
If already public with a token, returns existing token (idempotent)

steps.description: Create share router and enable endpoint
steps.details: Create server/src/routes/share.ts with mergeParams: true. POST /enable: 1) getOwnedProject. 2) If project.shareToken is null, generate new UUID: crypto.randomUUID(). 3) Update project: is_public = true, share_token = token (if not already set). 4) Return 200 { shareToken, shareUrl: FRONTEND_URL + '/share/' + token }.
Enable sharing — verify is_public=true and share_token set. Enable again — verify same token returned (idempotent). Share URL is correct format.
